Many years ago, Dave embarked on a career in real estate development. Being young and idealistic, he dreamed of building the perfect community. It would be a friendly relaxed place where neighbors not only knew each other but would actually do things together.

There would be lots of fun activities that would enrich the mind, body and even the soul. Exciting gathering areas, peaceful clusters of homes, recreation areas ﬁlled with enthusiastic players, and vibrant markets all of which would be interspersed with mystical nature preserves ﬁlled with majestic trees and wildlife. Cars would drive slower, cycling and walking would be preferred ways to travel. It was a beautiful dream.

The reality was he worked on master planned communities that had a golf course and some other amenities where he sold chunks of land to production builders. Each builder would focus on their site and not much else. The result was always the same. A collection of disconnected pieces - a bunch of homes in one area, a strip shopping center with a gym, an office building, a school, a park and maybe a church all operating independently on their piece of land. The car was the only way to go from one place to another. The residents tended to live in small, isolated groups.

For forty years Dave worked on those communities that were a disappointing reality, far removed from his dream. However, two years ago, Linette, his gorgeous wife, and he stumbled upon The Villages and at once they both cried out: “This is it!” Golf cars and gators were not part of the dream but should have been. It has been an incredible two years since they arrived. They made many friends, discovered new activities and started living a lifestyle they had only dreamed about. They are excited to have the opportunity to share their discovery of The Villages with you.

He has been a licensed real estate professional since 1988. Chris has held Real Estate Broker licenses in North Carolina, Georgia, and Florida.

After beginning his career practicing general residential and commercial real estate, Chris worked hard to become Vice President of Sales and Marketing for one of Metro Atlanta’s top builders and developers. He was recognized in 2005 by the National Sales and Marketing Council with the Chairman’s Sales Leadership Award for having reached 50 million in Sales and has also been recognized by the National Association of Realtors as a Lifetime Member of the Million Dollar Club.

Chris holds several designations offered by the National Association of Homebuilders including: the prestigious Masters in Residential Marketing (MIRM), Certified Marketing Professional (CMP), and Certified Aging in Place Specialist (CAPS) designations. Courses included Working with and Marketing to Older Adults, Lifestyle Merchandising, Advertising and Promotions, and Understanding Markets and Consumers. Currently there are less than 245 MIRM’s in the United States and only 27 in the State of Florida.

Lifelong learning has been an important aspect of Chris’s life. This was never more evident than in 2010 when at 50 years of age, he earned his Bachelor of Applied Science in Organizational Leadership from Mercer University. Chris earned an Associate’s Degree in Political Science in 1984 with the intention of attending Law school, however, as fate would have it, he decided to follow his father’s advice and pursue a career in real estate. After helping thousands of people successfully buy and sell real estate, Chris knows that his skills involve much more than housing. It involves people’s lives and their homes. Being entrusted with that responsibility is extremely humbling.

Chris and his wife Cynthia have two grown children Nicolette and Cameron, and two beautiful granddaughters Brooklyn and Sofia. Chris gives credit to God for giving him the many blessings in his life.

Chris has always believed that There Is Only One Proof of Ability... Results!

I am extremely grateful that my life’s journey has brought my wife and I to the The Villages as our forever home.  It is here that I have found the perfect opportunity to consolidate all of my previous professional and personal experiences while working as a licensed Real Estate Agent for The Villages.

I was blessed to have had the opportunity to play College Basketball at the University of Notre Dame and at Syracuse University. I worked on Wall Street for over 30 years, advising traders at some of Wall Street’s most prestigious firms (Morgan Stanley, JP Morgan, Goldman Sachs, Bank of America).  My expertise in market trends, market activity, market value and depth of market helped make trading decisions for these firms. I was also the President of my Homeowners association in New York for seven years and coordinated 3 major renovation projects during that time.  I have owned several rental units and been involved with REITS (Real Estate Investment Trusts).  The understanding of values, timing, strength of market and the duties of homeowner management have been invaluable to me here as a Licensed Real Estate Agent for the Villages.

Now as I have moved to advising people on marketing their homes for sale or purchasing their new home, I feel that all of my past professional experiences have culminated into an exciting new chapter.  In just my second year I was in the top 10% of the Sales force and earned my first ring in recognition of that accomplishment.  But most importantly I have made a whole new life and career with great new friends, colleagues, clients and neighbors.  My two children, son-in-law and two grandchildren, all love coming to visit us in our new home multiple times a year to dance in the square and enjoy the sunny Florida weather.

In 2023, she also earned the prestigious award for Most Pre-Owned Homes Sold, a title she previously secured in 2020, the same year she received the Rookie Award. In 2022, she maintained her stellar performance, ranking among the Top 20 Performers. Her accomplishments were further commemorated with the naming of her own street, “Crane Doran Place" in 2021.

Katie, originally from New Jersey but with a “Midwestern heart,” has always found her true home in Michigan, and later in Indiana, where she spent several years. Her journey to The Villages mirrors that of many others – it began with visits to her in-laws, who have been residents since 1990. From her inaugural trip in 2010, she felt the pull of The Villages and knew it was where she belonged. In 2019, Katie and her spouse Sara decided to make their dream a reality, purchasing their own piece of paradise in The Village of McClure.

Driven by a deep-seated passion for caring for others, Katie dedicated eight years to volunteering at the Center for Hospice House, as well as contributing her time to the Boys and Girls Club and Big Brothers/Big Sisters programs in Indiana before joining Properties of The Villages. With over 15 years of successful sales experience with a leading RV manufacturer in Indiana, Katie’s entrepreneurial spirit led her to establish her own “white glove” concierge service company, Red Diamond Services. Specializing in catering to the needs of top executive clients, Katie’s venture focused on managing their busy personal lifestyles and property needs.

As the fourth of five children, Katie takes pride in being the favorite Aunt to her numerous nieces and nephews. She finds joy in activities like water volleyball, beach tennis, and golf, alongside her spouse Sara, who shares her love for animals. Their household is always bustling with the presence of at least two dogs, and often they also care for horses at a nearby boarding facility.

Katie’s remarkable ability to understand her customers’ desires and guide them to their perfect homes reflects her genuine care and commitment. Whether it’s navigating one of life’s significant decisions or helping clients find their own Dream Home, Katie always has their best interests at heart.

Alysa Hritzik is a Central Florida native and has been a real estate agent in the area since 2002. She is a graduate of Florida State University with a bachelor’s degree in communications. Alysa began her real estate career in marketing for active adult communities and, when she saw how fun and rewarding it was to be a sales representative, she obtained her real estate license and made the switch! Over the past 23 years, Alysa has gained experience with first-time homebuyers, retirement and relocation buyers and sellers, property management, and distressed home sales.

Alysa has been married to her husband, Mike, for 22 years and they have a son and a daughter who attend The Villages Charter School. Mike owns Lake County Air Conditioning & Heating, and in their free time they enjoy fishing, boating, camping, snow skiing, traveling, hunting, and watching their children play soccer and golf. Alysa and Mike are both active in their church where he is an elder and she is a deacon. Alysa is a 2020 graduate of Leadership Lake County, an organization where current and emerging leaders are identified and recruited into the program. Alysa’s mother has been with Properties of The Villages since 2015 as a top producing professional and is the reason Alysa joined this incredible team.

“The most enjoyable aspect of real estate is getting to know my clients deeply. Helping to connect them to exactly what they are looking for in a home and community is a pleasure. Being a trusted source of information and guidance during the home-buying or selling process is both a privilege and a joy. I still stay in touch with my very first clients from back in 2002! They purchased a part-time Florida home with my help. We vacationed as a family in Maine a few years ago and even met up with them for breakfast in their hometown. I treat my clients like family and take my responsibility as their representative very seriously. Finding their dream home to live out the amazing retirement years is so much fun that it shouldn’t be called work!”

Angela began her real estate career in North Carolina in 2000 after the purchase of her first home. Having a true passion for helping others, she enjoyed assisting families through their journey of home ownership until the busy schedule of two young boys demanded late evening showings be replaced by football /baseball games and everything, BOY! Switching gears but always hoping to return to the career she loved, she found a flexible schedule with a family-owned automotive restyling company servicing dealership in NW North Carolina and Southern Virginia. Hard work, dedication, enthusiasm mixed with a little southern charm helped her gain record sales, happy customers, and many lifetime friends, which proves that it’s not what you do but how you do it that matters most! She attributes her success to always living by the Golden Rule. It’s a simple strategy to just treat everyone like you would want to be treated, but it makes a big impact. Whether it’s helping someone find their dream home or helping them select their new leather interior for their vehicle, listening to their needs and helping them achieve their goal as seamlessly and stress free as possible creates happy customers. There is no better feeling than to know you made a difference in someone’s life!

Always guided by faith, Angela is convinced it was no accident a chance conversation her husband Coby had with the ranger at their golf course in Winston Salem, NC lead them to The Villages. His stories and an extreme dislike for the winter weather sparked the first visit by Coby and his brother Allan in the winter of 2010. Returning home with more stories too good to be true, husbands and wives returned shortly thereafter. Angela still remembers that first visit and how amazed she was with the majestic oak trees, the friendly active people, and endless activities. You truly have to see it to believe it! It wasn’t long before Lynn and Allan, then Coby and Angela had purchased homes in Florida’s Friendliest Hometown and Angela begin dreaming of the possibilities of returning to her career in real estate. Since joining the Sales team in 2020, Angela has been living her dream helping others discover theirs!

“I am blessed and humbled with having the opportunity to share my love of The Villages. It is truly an honor to help others make their dream of living The Villages Lifestyle a reality! “

Renee Risch was born in Catskill, New York where most of her family is from and still lives today. When Renee was 3 her family moved to Birmingham, Alabama where she grew up and learned all about the LOVE of college football. Renee was involved in many activities such as softball, cheerleading, soccer, and dance line. Renee quickly fell in love with the Auburn Tigers where she later attended college at Auburn University and has a Bachelor of Science degree in Business Management.

Renee got her real estate license in 1997 and moved to Raleigh, North Carolina and worked in real estate. After several moves throughout North Carolina, Georgia and Texas, Renee went to work for Target Corporation and started her retail career while raising her family. She worked for Target for 15 years, having an incredible career and winning many awards for building teams, results, and profitability. After her career at Target, she was offered an incredible position to expand her creativity and skillset where she became the VP for Saks 5th Avenue and Saks Off 5th. She led large teams and had stores in numerous states throughout the country.

Troy Risch is originally from White Bear Lake, Minnesota. He was blessed to grow up in a suburb of St. Paul, Minnesota known for its hard work ethic and down to earth people. As a child he enjoyed being on the water in the summer and playing football, basketball, and tennis during the school year. Knowing he had to pay for college himself his goal was to attain a scholarship in sports. Achieving his goal Troy attended North Dakota State University in Fargo, ND. He attributes his success today from the determination, teamwork, and grit it took to practice in those conditions.

Troy graduated from college with a degree in Business Management in the fall of 1990 and quickly realized he wanted to be a part of a team during his career like he was in college and most of his life. He started his retail career in January of 1991 that sent him on an odyssey of incredible experiences and opportunities for over 30 years. Moving over 17 times, owning 13 different homes, and working with over 25 realtors throughout his career path, Troy knows what it takes to help you through one of the biggest changes in your life.

In 2017 Troy and Renee were married and between them they have 7 children, six daughters, McKenna, Haley, Mackenzie, Skylar, Elle, Gabrielle and one son, Jake. They are often called the Brady Bunch plus one minus Alice. The kids (who are no longer really kids) live all over the States in Nashville, Denver, Ft Lauderdale, NYC, San Diego, Boca, and Minneapolis. Both Troy and Renee’s parents also reside in The Villages. They built their first home in The Village of McClure in 2018 and now as typical Villagers are on their second home in The Village of St Catherine.

Renee and Troy both hold their Florida Real Estate License and work for The Villages as Sales Representatives. Their combined 60 years in personalized customer service, as well as relocating many times in their life, ensures that they understand the excitement, challenges and hurdles we all encounter on this journey. Know that their experience and hard work will help guide you through the entire process by focusing on your needs, satisfaction and most importantly, your happiness in mind. When you meet Troy and Renee you will see they exude a passion for life and the lifestyle that living in The Villages provides. It was their goal to get here as soon as they could to enjoy The Villages Lifestyle as long as they could, and they would love to help you do the same!

Recognized as the 2021 Representative of the Year - Rookie, 2021 Listing Representative of the Year - Rookie, and 2020-2021 Most Renter Sales - Rookie, Kimberly has consistently demonstrated a commitment to excellence in real estate. In 2021, she was also honored as the Sales Representative of the Year - Rookie and for achieving Most Pre-Owned Homes Sold - Rookie. Since joining the company, she has consistently ranked in the top 5% of sales representatives and is a proud member of the prestigious Ring Club, which honors agents who sell 40 or more homes per year. Most recently, in 2024, Kimberly was recognized as #12 in the company, further solidifying her dedication to outstanding service and results.

Selling real estate is in Kimberly’s DNA. After graduating from Northwest Missouri State University in 1995, she began her career at a 1,225-acre master-planned residential community in the Kansas City metropolitan area. As a Marketing Representative, Kimberly played a key role in the completion of 12 phases of upper bracket builds, overseeing marketing initiatives, managing the Senior PGA Tour, and driving recruitment and sales. Her contributions were recognized by the Home Builders Association and featured in the Top Performing Circle of Entrepreneurs. After a decade of success in real estate, Kimberly transitioned into special education, dedicating several years to teaching while raising her children through their elementary and middle school years. In 2009, she relocated with her family to Saint Augustine, Florida, where she became a Regional Sales Manager for a telecommunications company. With both her son and daughter serving in the United States Navy, Kimberly understands the importance of commitment, dedication, and service. She has chosen to live and work in The Villages and is dedicated to serving her clients — whether they are buying, selling, or building. Kimberly cares.

Shane’s grandparents moved from New Jersey to Florida for their retirement and his parents followed them before he and his brother Dylan were born. He is a native Floridian and grew up in Kissimmee, FL. He has enjoyed living in Central Florida so much that he obtained a bachelor’s degree from the University of Central Florida in Marketing in 2018.

Having served in a restaurant and worked for Disney throughout college, he grew to learn the importance of hospitality. Upon graduating from UCF, he worked for Tesla which helped him understand the importance of walking individuals through the purchasing process step-by-step to be a great resource for each of the folks he works with. Shane obtained his real estate license in 2020 with a desire to work in The Villages. With so many enthusiastic, passionate, and active residents to work along-side and serve; he knew that The Villages was something special.

Shane is very active. He is part of a soccer team that plays weekly in Orlando. He is also involved with skateboarding and tennis to keep him heavily active. Shane likes to spend his free time traveling in the great outdoors, including a yearly ski trip and a yearly hiking trip.

Christian’s idyllic childhood was spent swimming in local lakes and playing baseball in a small shore town in the Pine Barrens of New Jersey.  At the age of thirteen, his family relocated to a village town located east of the beautiful historic city of Charleston where he gained an appreciation for Southern hospitality and manners. At the age fourteen, he began his first job at a café on the Isle of Palms in South Carolina.  Little did he realize that this would be the start of an amazing twenty-five-year career in the hospitality industry.

In 2004, Christian moved to Winter Park, Florida to work for Chef Emeril Lagasse’s restaurant at Universal Studios.  In just a few short years, due to hard work and a passion to provide excellent customer service, Christian worked his way from Food Runner, Captain, Bartender to Sommelier.

Five years later, Christian accepted a position with the famous family owned long-time New York restaurant, The Palm, in Orlando where he remained for eleven years.  Once again, he worked his way up and in seven years became Operations Manager.  In 2020, Christian decided it was time for a more family-friendly career change.

In 2015, Christian married a local girl, Gina Martin. Two years later they were blessed with a beautiful baby boy, Kai.  It was through Gina that Christian learned about The Villages, her parents had resided in the Village of Liberty Park for over fifteen years. Christian, Gina and son Kai have personally enjoyed many wonderful evenings exploring the shops and entertainment in the town squares and dining in many of the amazing restaurants offered in The Villages. They even held their rehearsal dinner at the Evans Prairie Country Club.

When considering a career change, Christian knew he wanted to be associated with The Villages. Many individuals associated with The Villages encouraged Christian to obtain a Real Estate License and become part of the family-orientated community.

Today, Christian is proud to be a part of The Villages and explains,

“I know in my heart this is where I am meant to be. I will strive to be the best person that I can possibly be and always be available to help in anyway.  I want to see you in the home of your dreams and enjoy the exciting lifestyle offered here in The Villages. I would be honored to be considered a part of your family.”

Sam has lived his entire life near The Villages. He attended The Villages Charter Schools from 2000-2012, becoming the first class to go from 1st grade to 12th grade in the school program. Growing up in Central Florida, Sam spent most of his childhood outdoors fishing, hunting, and playing sports. Sam was a member of the 2011-12 District Champion Football team as well as the Goalkeeper for the soccer team at The Villages Charter High School.

Both of Sam’s parents work inside The Villages; his mother Ladonna Zimmerman has been with Properties of The Village for over 22 years, and his father Scott Sullivan has been working with Citizens First Bank for over 30+ years. Having seen firsthand the love and dedications his parents put into their work here in The Villages, Sam was eager to get his entrepreneurial start and begin contributing to this amazing community. His very first job was at Arnold Palmer Legends where he got to experience a lot of hard work, responsibility, and customer service. Most recently, Sam was employed at The Villages Golf cars in Brownwood Paddock Square where he sold golf cars; one of The Villages special ways of transportation.

In his free time, Sam enjoys being outside as much as possible. He is an avid outdoorsman who loves to hike, backpack, kayak, and camp at National Parks all over the country. His favorite place he has been so far is Acadia National Park in Maine. Sam grew up a huge Florida Gator fan and loves to tailgate on the weekends and hang out with his friends. Occasionally you will see Sam riding around town with his side-kick Rocco, his one-year old Boxer pup hanging out the passenger window.

“The Villages is truly the place where people’s dreams come true. Having grown up in this community, I have seen firsthand how much pride, love and support is here in each neighborhood. That is what drives me every day to serve this community to the fullest. I am so excited be a part of Properties of The Villages, and look forward to helping make your retirement dreams come true”

Born and raised in Washington, West Virginia, Tresha is the youngest of four children and grew up enjoying an active outdoor lifestyle filled with boating, water skiing, softball, basketball, cheerleading, and time with friends.

After high school, she entered the optical industry, earned her American Board of Opticians license, and spent 26 years managing optical stores. In 2012, she fulfilled a promise to her parents by returning to college. She earned her Associate Degree in 2013 — the same year her oldest son graduated from high school — and then she continued her education while working full-time and raising her family. In 2016, she graduated from West Virginia University at Parkersburg with a Bachelor's Degree in Communications.

Her husband's career change brought the family to Florida. After learning about The Villages Charter School, the family chose to make their home in Oxford, just outside The Villages.

After spending several months learning about The Villages and its unique lifestyle, she took a leap of faith and left the optical industry and earned her real estate license. Over the past nine years, Tresha has served in several roles with The Villages, including Guest Coordinator and Relocation Specialist, gaining valuable knowledge of the community before joining a top-performing sales team. She now has the privilege of helping clients make their retirement dreams a reality.

Family remains at the center of everything she does. Her parents, who have been married for 59 years, eventually followed her to The Villages and now enjoy the lifestyle she has shared with so many clients over the years. Nothing brings her more joy than the title of being a grandma, aka 'Gigi'. She loves having her granddaughter close by and cherishes visits with her grandson when they come to visit.

Her philosophy is simple: treat every client the way she would want her own parents and grandparents to be treated. She looks forward to welcoming you to this wonderful community and helping you discover how your retirement dreams can become reality.

Jim was born and raised in Poughkeepsie, NY, the same place where he met his wife Cheri in high school over 38 years ago. He attended SUNY Cobleskill and Rochester Institute of Technology where he earned his degree in Hospitality Management. Upon graduation, Jim had the privilege of working for The Walt Disney World Company in Lake Buena Vista for 8 years. He later moved to the Chicago, Illinois suburbs for 5 years and then to Columbus, Ohio where he continued to provide hospitality services for 17 years throughout multiple states.

Jim’s parents moved to The Villages in 2014 and both have said that they wish they had done it sooner. After visiting several times Jim and Cheri decided this was where they wanted to work and live the dream themselves. You will find them enjoying the nature trails, biking, swimming, the local Farmer’s Markets, social events, town squares, and dining at many of the restaurants, as well as spending as much time as they can with family. They have 2 grown sons. Chris attended Ohio State University and Ryan attended Ohio University. After visiting The Villages multiple times, they also moved to Florida with their girlfriends and are living in the area.

Jim is known for his customer service, patience, integrity, and good nature. His hospitality career has included providing services to those in education, healthcare, corrections, corporate offices, and resorts. He has a varied background that ranges from creating “Magical Moments” for families to working alongside corporate executives to improve associate’s experiences and environments.

“Throughout my career, I find it most rewarding to help others through hard work, sharing my knowledge, and genuinely treating people how I would like to be treated. Working for Properties of The Villages as a Sales Representative allows me to introduce folks to a lifestyle that many have found to be rewarding, relaxing, and great fun!”

Jim is honored to have the privilege to learn about you and help you realize your dream of finding an active community where you can enjoy your retirement.

A true local to The Villages area with over 20 years of firsthand experience, Quinn’s connection to the community runs deeper than most. She first became part of The Villages at age 15, working in concessions at the original Rialto Theatre in Spanish Springs. What began as a first job quickly grew into a lasting connection—one that has evolved into a deep understanding of the community, its people, and the lifestyle she now helps others call home.

Quinn studied at the University of South Florida as a Florida Merit Scholar, focusing on business marketing and photography. She began her career in the mortgage industry before launching and operating a successful photography company specializing in marketing, product, and real estate imagery. This combination of financial knowledge and visual strategy gives her a distinct advantage, providing her clients with a competitive edge when buying or selling.

Licensed in real estate since 2018, Quinn gained experience with Douglas Elliman Real Estate before returning to The Villages in 2020 to serve the community she has always called home. She is known for guiding buyers and sellers with clarity, honesty, and a highly personalized approach—ensuring each client feels understood, informed, and confident throughout the process.

As a proud mom of two teenage boys, Liam and Ledger, Quinn understands the importance of home on a deeper level. It’s not just about square footage--it’s about lifestyle, comfort, and creating a place where life happens.

Known for her local expertise, approachable style, and genuine care, Quinn takes the time to listen and tailor each experience to the individual. Whether you’re just beginning your search or ready to make a move, she provides a seamless, strategic, and well-supported experience from start to finish.

My one and only goal is to help you, our amazing residents, or future residents by making your dreams come true. The Villages community is unique in so many ways, you deserve someone that knows the community and can help you reach your dreams whatever they may be.

Growing up, my family and I have had the opportunity to reside across the country including New Hampshire, Colorado, Virginia, New Jersey, Pennsylvania, and Florida. The many relocations have afforded me an understanding of the stress and unknown that each of you goes through when selling, moving and purchasing a new home in a new city and state. Playing team sports growing up has taught me the importance of listening to those around me and truly hearing what others are saying, acting on that information only to make sure we grow together in our journey.

If we have the opportunity to work together, I know you will find comfort in our ability to learn and find out what makes you happy to get out of bed in the morning and enjoy life. Nothing will be more important than our ability to find out if The Villages is the right place for you. I myself purchased in a Villages family community and I have been very happy.​

Cindy Lee Brown brings over a decade of real estate expertise and a lifelong commitment to exceptional customer service to every client interaction. Before transitioning into real estate, Cindy worked as a flight attendant — an experience that honed her ability to listen attentively, anticipate needs, and create a calm, welcoming environment. These skills now set her apart in today’s fast-paced housing market.

Her real estate knowledge spans everything from new construction, to personalized builds, to listing and selling well-loved homes. Whether her clients are buying their forever home, investing in a seasonal getaway, upsizing for more space, or downsizing to a lifestyle-focused property, Cindy understands it’s never just about the house, it’s about the life that unfolds within it.

Known for her approachable, relationship-driven style and no-pressure approach, Cindy is deeply dedicated to helping others write their next chapter — and make it the best one yet. She takes the time to truly understand each client’s goals, offering personalized guidance and steady support throughout every step of the journey.

When she’s not helping others find their dream home, Cindy enjoys living the lifestyle she promotes. You’ll often find her walking the trails with her dog Molly, riding her bike, visiting local farmers’ markets and art festivals, volunteering at her church, or taking a kickboxing class for fun and fitness.

Originally from the Main Line area just outside of Philadelphia, PA Michelle Talley has also lived in Delaware, South Carolina and Virginia. An East Coast girl all the way, Michelle now enjoys living in The Villages with her husband, exploring all that this amazing hometown has to offer.

Shortly after graduating from the University of Delaware with a bachelor’s degree in Elementary Education & Middle School Math, Michelle moved to Charleston, SC and spent 17 years in the restaurant industry. It was there, in Charleston, where she met her wonderful husband, Josh, who at the time was in the United States Navy. Not long after they wed, Michelle first started selling real estate in South Carolina, in 2007. Upon completion of Josh's military career, he was offered a job with Areva & they moved to Lynchburg, VA and Michelle continued her real estate career there.

Buying a home is the American Dream & Michelle still remembers buying her first home. Tingles, jitters, happiness and fear are only some of the emotions she felt when attempting her first investment. Since that first experience, there have been several more investment properties that she and Josh have purchased or sold and Michelle remembers putting herself in the same position you are. What a great reminder of all the twists and turns this wild ride can take you on no matter which side of the transaction you are pursuing!

Michelle tends to do things a little differently and truly loves getting to know her clients on a personal level...after all, buying or selling a home is one of the most personal, most valuable choices a person may decide to make in their entire life.  There are always bumps in the road but as your sales representative she promises to make it as smooth of a ride as possible. That promise helped her achieve the award of Lynchburg Living’s "Best Of" Real Estate Agents Award in Virginia. Michelle has also earned a 4.9-STAR RATING with over 130 Client reviews on Zillow:

"Michelle has helped us 3 times now, both as the buyers and as the sellers. She is honest, detail-oriented, and knowledgeable. She has always listened to our goals and expectations and exceeded them every time. She is easy to talk to and guided us each step along the way, providing valuable information and concise communication. She is always prompt and available to meet or take a phone call when necessary. Communication was easy, and most transactions/signatures could be handled electronically. We have now moved out of the area and I don't think we will ever find another realtor like her!"

When she's not helping her customers, Michelle is very active in her community. She has been a lead coordinator for Financial Peace University since 2008, former board member of Young Professionals of Central Virginia & volunteered at the Miller Home for Girls. Michelle & Josh also love spending time with their "girls" - Abbie & Ivy who are their Labradors. They enjoy "tootling" around on the golf car, with the girls and a stroll at one of the squares. Michelle also loves to golf, play tennis, pickleball & is an avid runner with several races under her belt from 5Ks to Marathons!

 
So, whether buying or selling for your personal residence or as an investment, Michelle would be honored to help! She looks forward to your call :) Oh, by the way...Michelle is never too busy for your referrals as well!​

Diane is from Long Island, New York. She and her husband Michael have been married since 1993 and have four children, two cats and a bird. Diane and her husband bought their first home in The Villages in 2015 after visiting their best friend who retired and moved here. They are now looking forward to living up the block from him in The Village of Chitty Chatty. Diane also loves a good cup of coffee so you can be sure she’ll be happy to make time for a cup with you if you’re out with her!

“Be the reason someone smiles today” is one of Diane’s favorite quotes. Helping others has always been a guiding motivation in her life. She was an active community volunteer and helped found a charitable not-for profit organization where she lived previously. Diane and her board were able to create a school district food pantry, community clean up events, establish a chamber of commerce for local businesses, assist veterans in the town American Legion and partnered with local government officials and police to get grants and address community concerns.

Diane pursued her real estate license to be able to continue her love of helping others in The Villages.

“I am excited and honored to be living and working in The Villages because I believe there’s at least a million reasons to smile here every day!”

Diane is looking forward to the opportunity to assist you with helping to make your dream come true living here in The Villages.

Jackie Veri brings warmth, dedication, and a keen eye for detail to every real estate transaction. Fluent in English and Spanish, she thrives on making people feel welcome and valued, whether in her home, community, or work as a Licensed Real Estate Professional with Properties of The Villages. Her passion lies in helping buyers find the perfect home and guiding sellers to maximize their property’s value, ensuring a seamless and rewarding experience.

Born and raised in Puerto Rico, Jackie moved to Florida in 2001, where she lives a life centered around faith, family, and service. She married her husband, Michael, in 2010, and together they have seven children, two grandchildren, and two lively dogs, Maximus and Cooper, who keep their household full of energy and love.

Jackie’s background in hospitality and customer service shines in her real estate career. From retail to roles with the US Postal Service, a children’s nonprofit, ministry, and healthcare, she’s consistently sought to uplift those around her. She carries this dedication into real estate, offering exceptional service tailored to her customers’ needs. Her natural ability to connect with people and her attention to detail make her an invaluable resource for anyone looking to buy or sell in The Villages.

Jackie’s knack for detail shines in both her work and home life, whether it’s a perfectly placed pillow or the small details that turn a house into a dream home. She lives by Bob Marley’s words: “The greatness of a man is not in how much wealth he acquires, but in his integrity and his ability to affect those around him positively.”

Jackie teams up with Michael, a Broker Associate at Properties of The Villages, to turn dreams into reality. She strives to make your home-buying and selling process stress-free and enjoyable. Whether you’re searching for your perfect home or preparing to sell, she’d love to help you achieve your real estate goals with care, expertise, and a personal touch.

Miranda was born and raised in Brooksville Florida. She moved to Ocoee FL and attended West Orange High School where she met her high school sweetheart Randy. They married a year after graduation and moved to Lady Lake and have made The Villages community a part of their family ever since.

Having been here since 2000, both of their children attended The Villages Charter school. Their son Corey is now a Builder for The Villages and their daughter Cylie is currently a Junior in the Graphic Design Academy.

Miranda earned her Associates in Arts Degree from Lake Sumter State College. She has over 15 years of experience in the construction and design industry and has decided to bring her expertise along with her passion to help others to The Villages Sales Team. Her top priority is to help make your retirement dreams come true. She will listen to your needs and wants as she helps you through the journey to your retirement dreams. She thrives on making lasting relationships in and outside of her career.

Jordyn Rottermond has proudly served clients in The Villages community for over 13 years, bringing a strong background in finance, exceptional attention to detail, and a genuine passion for helping people navigate one of life’s most important decisions. Her experience in the banking and finance industry helped shape her ambitious yet personable approach, allowing her to build lasting relationships while delivering professional and attentive service to every client.

Originally from south of Detroit, Michigan, Jordyn spent many years visiting The Villages to see her grandparents, who began coming to the community in the early 2000s. Watching The Villages grow into the vibrant and nationally recognized lifestyle community it is today inspired Jordyn to become deeply involved both personally and professionally. During her time in the finance industry, she earned both her Series 6 and Life Insurance licenses, expanding her knowledge of financial planning, customer service, and client relations. Inspired by her mother, Nikki Perry, Jordyn decided to take her career to the next level by combining her financial expertise with her passion for real estate and community service.

Outside of real estate, Jordyn enjoys spending quality time with her children and staying active with their busy baseball schedules. When they are not at the ball field, she loves spending time outdoors fishing, boating, and exploring Florida’s beautiful springs and waterways.

“I love surrounding myself and my children with the positivity that radiates throughout our community. I feel incredibly blessed to live and serve in The Villages, and I’m excited to help others discover just how special this lifestyle truly is.”

With a positive, energetic, and efficient approach, Jordyn is dedicated to guiding clients through every step of their real estate journey while making the experience enjoyable, seamless, and rewarding.

Ben Giardini was born in the Village of Allegany located in Western New York. He attended college at West Virginia University and then SUNY Brockport. Since college, Ben has had various careers including computer sales, e-Commerce management, and heavy equipment operator. Some of Ben’s hobbies are cooking, golfing, and woodworking. He moved to Florida to pursue his passion for Real Estate and making others dreams come true. They enjoy live entertainment and have attended numerous concerts at the Savannah Center and Sharon Morse Performing Arts Center. They also love the active lifestyle, and you can find them strolling around their neighborhood every morning with their friends. Rolynn's dad has played countless water volleyball games, and her mom has played many mahjong and card games, as well as attended various workout group classes.

Besides the lifestyle, Rolynn's parents can't stop raving about how great the community is and the opportunities available for everyone. Having an interest in real estate, Rolynn left the corporate world to explore the real estate industry and what it has to offer. One thing she knew was that she only wanted to be a part of The Properties of The Villages because of all the great and positive things she's heard from residents and guests about how they are treated and valued.

Outside of work, Rolynn spends a lot of time with her family watching movies. Like her parents, she also loves attending concerts. She travels to different places with her husband Peter and, so far, their favorites are Boston and Houston. She considers herself a foodie and is willing to try new food as long as it's not spicy. She also likes to bake and one day hopes to perfect her chocolate chip cookie recipe and banana bread recipe.

Rolynn is an enthusiastic and dedicated individual whose number one goal is to make it easy for you to find your next dream home. She's willing to assist in any way possible, and she can't wait to get to know and work with you!

Russ was raised in Rhode Island in a city north of Providence called Central Falls. It is an old industrial revolution age city built around the factories on the banks of the Blackstone River. He worked as a paperboy, fast food server and factory worker to help pay for his Catholic high school education. His father was a firefighter in Central Falls and Russ worked there each summer as a vacation replacement. It was while working at a local caterer where he met his future wife, Linda.

Educated at both Bryant University and University of RI, Russ embarked on his first career of being a software developer in the Boston area. During that time, he and Linda raised three children, twins Kelley and Christopher and a younger son Mathew in the town of Norton, Massachusetts. He would see The Villages advertisements on weekend golf tournaments and he and Linda knew that this would be where they wanted to be.

In a twist of fate, the IT company that Russ worked for struggled during the depression of 2008. Russ seized the opportunity to begin training as a Registered Nurse in preparation for a move to The Villages. Upon arrival in Florida, he worked as an RN at The Villages Hospital, and later with Cornerstone Hospice as an admission nurse. In their spare time, both Russ and Linda are avid golfers and host their six grandchildren who visit as often as they can.

Living in The Villages since 2010, he has seen the tremendous growth of his new hometown and loves to share the joy that he and Linda have found with everyone they meet. Embarking on a third career of working with Properties of The Villages allows him to aid others in their search for that dream retirement.

“Moving to The Villages was a great decision and I can now help others find their perfect home. Working for Properties of The Villages has been a goal of mine since moving here and now I have the opportunity to fulfill that dream.”

Steve grew up in St. Petersburg, Florida, after a couple of short stays in Louisville, KY and Upper Nyack, NY.  After graduating from High School in St. Pete, Steve attended Tulane University in New Orleans, LA majoring in Computer Science and Math.  After graduation, Steve moved to the Dallas area to begin his career in Telecommunications where he developed software to enable telephone calls and calling features for traditional landline services, as well as for the early phases of cellular services.  Steve continued his cellular telecommunications career in Boca Raton, FL and for the last 21 years in Columbia, MD.

After making the decision to leave telecommunications in 2020, Steve, along with his wife Gigi, moved to The Villages to fully enjoy the lifestyle that is offered here.  A quick visit to The Villages made the decision to move here a quick and easy one.

Gigi and Steve are also very lucky and honored to have both of their children follow them to The Villages, Middleton, specifically.  Both Tom and Megan are also working for The Villages.  Tom works as a Guest Coordinator, coordinating Lifestyle Preview Stays for future residents and Megan works as a Senior Data Analyst in the Accounting department.  After just a couple of visits to see Mom and Dad, and they decided to move down to join the fun.

Steve also enjoys travelling, meeting people, and enjoying The Villages lifestyle.  In his travels he has visited six of the seven continents and still needs to make it to Antarctica to complete the list, as his parents did. Steve enjoys working with the Properties of The Villages which gives him the opportunity to meet new people and help them learn everything that The Villages has to offer, whether a favorite activity that they love or trying something new that they have always dreamed about doing.  “I look forward to helping everyone achieve their retirement dreams in The Villages.”

Dylan is living his own Florida dream. Growing up in Vancouver, Canada, he was always fascinated and attracted to Florida. As a young adult he created a vision to one day have a palm tree in his yard and set off to chase that goal by moving to Toronto and Calgary before venturing into Virginia and Boston. In 2021 he and his wife reached that milestone by purchasing a home in The Villages.

As a Villages resident, Dylan can offer a genuine tour experience. He has immersed himself in The Villages lifestyle, joining several activities and clubs. If you like craft beer and corvettes, you will get along smashingly with Dylan. As a relatively new Villager he also has firsthand experience of what it is like to purchase in this busy active market so Dylan can help you navigate the emotions that come with finding the home of your dreams.

Having spent 25 years in the hospitality business, in every role from dishwasher to general manager, as a guest of Dylan you can expect to feel welcomed and cared for. He will develop a house hunting plan that is tailored to your unique needs. “Together, we can work toward making your retirement dreams come true!”

With more than eighteen years of real estate sales experience, ilona brown brings a wealth of knowledge and genuine caring and concern for the customer experience. She is honored to be part of The Villages team as a Sales Representative and looks forward to helping residents realize their dreams each and every day as a trusted advisor.

ilona speaks English, French, Spanish, and Hebrew, and has lived all over the world. Her international background, combined with extensive real estate, business development, public relations and speaking experience, renders her an expert communicator.

Not only does she focus on each client's individual lifestyle dreams and goals, while providing service that goes above and beyond, she has unique knowledge and insight from her experience as real estate agent, investor, and speaker.

ilona’s desire to participate philanthropically and bring the community together inspired her to organize several fundraisers at The Comedy Store in Los Angeles, California on behalf of POR (a non-profit helping families affected by cancer) as well as Camp Kesem a nationwide organization that provides camp experiences for children whose families have been affected by cancer.

She looks forward to continuing to serve The Villages for many years to come, both as a sales representative and in a philanthropic capacity.

Growing up in a small town in the mountains of North Carolina, Shane had a passion for adventure and traveling. In 2002, he joined the U.S. Army went on the serve for 20+ years both in the States and Overseas. While in the Army, he graduated from the Grand Canyon University with a Bachelor’s in Business Management and a Master’s in Business Analytics. In his travels he heard of The Villages and knew he needed to visit and once here he instantly fell in love with the community. Shane is constantly active in the community and is amazed by all the growth and opportunities that the area has to offer.

Shane has six children: four boys and two girls. Being a father of six active kiddos means that he is their biggest coach, guide, and person they look to for strength at baseball tournaments, basketball games and swim meets. During their downtime, they enjoy hiking fishing, rock climbing, swimming, and spending quality time together. Going to the gym, motorcycle rides, and hanging out with family and friends are some of Shane’s favorite pastimes. He enjoys living life and has devoted himself to serving the community.

Along with being a Soldier, Shane has experience in real estate. He always goes above and beyond to give his customers the best experience possible. “Helping others search for their perfect home is not about helping them find where they’re going to live, it’s about helping them enjoy their best life.”

Robbie's focus is doing what’s right for his clients. He brings an extensive background in relationship management after a 14-year career in banking. His background allows him to get a deep understanding of just what a client is seeking. He brings a personal, tailored approach to helping people find the home of their dreams, and he looks forward to the opportunity to help you!

Robbie and his family moved to Central Florida in 1999 where he finished high school in the Ocala area. After high school, he graduated from the University of North Florida with a degree in Business Management. After spending the majority of his career in banking in The Villages, it was time to forge a new path. After working in The Villages for the past 9 years, he knew Properties of The Villages was the team for him and is extremely blessed to have the opportunity.

In his free time, he enjoys spending time with his family. Watching his 3-year-old son grow has become the pride of his life. He looks forward to what each new day will bring and is thankful and blessed.

Mike was born and raised in Kentucky, moved to Florida in 2010, and is currently living in Ocala, FL. He and his wife Amanda were married in 2017 and have a sweet little girl, Ava Rose, who was born in July 2021.

Mike loves his family, music, boating, and a good cup of coffee! His family is most important to him, and he loves to help others. He is very involved in his church, serving weekly as a worship leader and playing acoustic guitar on the worship team.

An interesting fact about Mike is that he has two music degrees, one in music education from The University of Tennessee and the other in trombone performance from Florida State University.

Mike joined The Villages team in 2022 and has served in other real estate and construction roles before coming on the team.

He is honored to be working in The Villages and helping others make their dreams come true. He wanted to join The Properties of The Villages team because of their core values of Hospitality, Stewardship, Innovation, Creativity, and Hard Work, which he and his family believe in.

Whether you are moving here for the first time, moving within the community, or coming down for the season, Mike looks forward to the opportunity to help you make those dreams a reality.

With a passion to please and a heart to serve Robert comes to The Properties of The Villages Sales Team with a zeal for helping people find their biggest smile yet. Robert is a life-long resident of the Central Florida area and is humbled that such an amazing place to work and live is right in his back yard.

With a broad range of work experience he gets his biggest excitement from helping others find their joy in life. Joining the team with Properties of The Villages gives him that opportunity like no other. Having spent well over a decade in the world of coaching football Robert understands the values of teamwork, chemistry, and servant leadership. It is his focus to utilize every tool at his disposal to ensure that his clients find their perfect fit here in The Villages.

Having grown up the son of an entrepreneur Robert was able to see top notch examples of how placing the needs and desires of others above your own creates a next level experience. In every client interaction he aims to leave no doubt in their minds that they and their happiness is his main focus.

The opportunity to join the team with The Villages was one Robert feels beyond blessed to have, and he can’t wait to put his wide array of life experience towards serving his clients of both current and future Villagers. Selfless service is a motto he holds dear to his heart and the culture within The Villages stokes that fire to burn more passionately than ever. Robert can't wait to serve you and help be a small part of your big decision to be the newest resident to join The Villages!

Family ties are what brought Dani, and her husband Bill, to explore central Florida as they began to plan for Bill’s retirement. While vacationing and visiting Dani’s dad in Homosassa, they took day trips to retirement communities all over central Florida. “It was the manicured environment, abundance of indoor and outdoor recreation and social activities, and absolutely the friendliest people” that led them back to The Villages every time!

Helping clients through the decisions to find their dream home is a fantasy come true for Dani. Drawing on her nine years of experience in new construction sales and marketing for Drees Homes in her hometown of Dayton, Ohio, and her own experience in building their dream home in The Village of Hawkins, Dani knows the ropes and is eager to share.

As Dani says, knowing your client is key. “Understanding their lifestyle, their wants and needs in retirement, their budget and even health and family concerns, allows me to guide my clients to the best possible active retirement decision.”

“I would be honored to a be part of YOUR dream home decision. Come join us in “The Villages!”

Born in Detroit, Michigan, Joe Robinson was the first of seven siblings to be brought into the world. Being the oldest, he found that he had to quickly become a protector and a leader. From a young age, Joe has always been a very curious and adventurous person.

Graduating in the top of his class from Michigan Institute of Aviation and Technology, Joe became an aircraft mechanic at the age of nineteen. After graduation, he was offered a position at Lockheed Martin to deploy with a special operations branch of the United States Air Force to take care of their fleet of unmanned aircraft, which he did for seven years. By always putting in 100% effort and leaving no stone unturned, he quickly climbed the ranks to become the youngest Senior Level Engineer at Lockheed Martin.

Joe relocated to Florida, so he could enjoy the vacation-like lifestyle on his time off from work. He loves trips to the beach and natural springs. You can also find him flipping around on the freestyle motocross ramp. Shortly after moving to FL, he found the love of his life, Shauna Coppola, a Sales Representative for Properties of The Villages. Five years later they got married and are the proud parents of two dogs and a wild cat, Daisy, Blossom, and Petunia.

After retiring from his overseas deployments, he pursued a career as a successful home inspector, where he learned everything there is to know about the homes in The Villages. While home inspecting was interesting, Joe's favorite part of the job was always interacting with the homeowners. Through the years, Joe watched Shauna help Villagers dreams come true, and decided he wanted to follow in her footsteps. He wants to guide people to the same happiness he has found since moving to The Villages.

Joe is dedicated to living life to the fullest. After all these years Joe is still putting in 100% effort and leaving no stone unturned, but now with your real estate needs! Excited to meet you, Joe is ready and willing to guide you through your next steps to the adventure of a lifetime.

Carrie Jo Osborne grew up right here in Oxford, Florida on a 100-acre farm that has been in the family since the 1800s. She is the youngest of 6 children and a daughter to parents that have been married for over 50 years. That farm is still family owned and worked by her parents to this very day.

Carrie Jo and her spouse Cori are happily married with 2 sons, Aaron and Gavin, who are their sunshine and joy. She hates cooking, probably because she’s not very good at it, but thankfully Cori is great in the kitchen. In her spare time, you will find Carrie Jo with her family, running, practicing yoga, gardening, or kayaking. She enjoys taking at least 1 overnight solo hiking trip a year to ground herself back to nature.

Carrie Jo’s first job was with Citizens First Bank in The Villages. She spent 20 years in banking and always remembered the foundation of exceptional customer service that Citizens First instilled early in her career. She is very excited to be back in the community she knows and loves. Growing up on the farm was never easy but Carrie Jo was taught southern hospitality, values, integrity, and strong work ethic. She is ready make your experience memorable.

“I am not just helping you buy or sell a home. I am helping you create your best life in the retirement community where people can live the active lifestyle of their dreams.”

“I look forward to helping you start your journey!”

Robin Stucker is a warm, community-focused real estate professional who brings a lifetime of people-first experience to every client interaction. A graduate of Indiana University with a degree in elementary education, Robin began her career with a passion for helping others learn and grow — a passion that carries through everything she does. She spent many years in sales with Ameritech and Angie’s List and later in medical device sales, where her empathy, clear communication, and commitment to service earned the trust of colleagues and clients alike.

Now proudly serving homebuyers and sellers in The Villages, Florida, Robin combines deep local knowledge with strong negotiation skills and a genuine desire to make the process easy and joyful. Her background in education and customer-focused sales gives her a unique ability to listen, explain options clearly, and advocate for the best outcome for each client.

Robin is a proud mother of five children, four of whom were lovingly adopted, and family is at the heart of her values. She enjoys traveling and embracing the active, social lifestyle of The Villages. Whether you’re buying your first home, downsizing, or searching for the perfect retirement retreat, Robin’s compassionate approach and proven sales experience make her a trusted partner to help you achieve your goals.

Jared's connection to Florida's Friendliest Hometown spans more than two decades. After growing up in Colorado Springs, he moved to Central Florida in time to watch Lake Sumter Landing Market Square and Brownwood Paddock Square rise from the ground up, giving him a unique appreciation for the community's growth and the lifestyle it offers.

For years, Jared served residents and visitors through FMK Restaurant Group, where hospitality, exceptional service, and genuine connection became the foundation of his approach to serving others. Those experiences reinforced his belief that the best service comes from listening, building relationships, and making every person feel welcomed and valued.

Real estate was a natural next step, allowing Jared to combine his passion for serving others with his love for The Villages. He describes his role with Properties of The Villages as "feeling retired before retirement," giving him the opportunity to help others discover a lifestyle he genuinely enjoys while building lasting relationships along the way.

As a father, Jared has also experienced firsthand the value of The Villages Charter School, further strengthening his appreciation for everything this community has to offer.

When he's not helping customers find their dream home, Jared enjoys running local 5Ks, attending concerts at The Sharon, cheering on football, and exploring local restaurants. For Jared, The Villages isn't simply where he lives. It's a community he truly loves sharing with others, and he considers it a privilege to help customers begin their next chapter here.

Originally from a small town in northern New Jersey, Alissa has been a Florida resident since 1991. She moved to the sunshine state to attend college in Miami where she earned her bachelor’s degrees in both Biology and Chemistry from Florida International University.

Being a teacher was not her original plan, but it quickly became her passion. Sharing her love for science at the high school and middle school level was where she spent the first 20 years of her career. Eventually, she decided to earn her Master’s degree and became a Dean of Students for 6 years.

Alissa is a firm believer in lifelong learning and in serving others. She feels so fortunate to have had the opportunity to help so many students and families throughout her career. She has witnessed the fruits of her labor in so many ways. Attending high school and even college graduations, weddings, baby showers and college sporting events of former students are just a few of the things that demonstrate that her life’s work was truly a gift.

Along with serving others, Alissa’s heart lies with her family.  She is the mother to one son who attends Georgia Southern University.  She is married to her husband of 22 years and enjoys spending time with him and her 2 dogs. Alissa feels blessed to be a part of The Villages where she is able to continue helping others and share in their joy while making their dreams come true.

Samantha is a Florida native and has been dedicated to working and serving others in The Villages since 1992. She started at her dad’s home improvement business, “Orange Blossom Home Improvements” in the original area of The Villages. She went on to earn her Bachelor of Science Degree in Elementary Education from UCF and her Master’s Degree in Educational Leadership from UWF. She enjoyed 17 wonderful years of teaching at The Villages Charter School.

Samantha has had the amazing opportunity of watching The Villages grow over the years and feels so blessed to be involved in the community. “It is a community like no other. It has grown vastly over the years, but still maintains its high values and hometown feeling.”

Samantha and her charming husband, Ronnie, share a blended family of four children, Walter, Elora, Alex and Mari, and their excitable pooch, Oakley. She enjoys soaking up the Florida sunshine, especially while navigating through the beautiful freshwaters of Florida’s lakes and rivers. She also enjoys a nice glass of wine with her friends.

Samantha’s southern roots and family values of honesty, relationships, and integrity are what guide her in her life and business. She has a passion for people and her ability to connect with them is truly a gift. She has a natural skill set for listening and understanding the needs of her customers in order to create lifelong relationships.

She will bring these values to enhance your dream home searching experience. She would love to have the opportunity to work with you.

Julie Raketich is a Florida native who grew up just 30 minutes from The Villages in nearby Mount Dora, Florida. Julie’s small-town upbringing taught her the value of community and hospitality, which has given her a deep appreciation for the welcoming, hometown feel of The Villages.

Julie attended the University of Florida where she earned her bachelor’s degree in Elementary Education and met her husband, Gary. After graduation, Julie and Gary moved to Orlando, FL where Julie began her career as an elementary school teacher and a cast member at Walt Disney World, two roles that offered Julie the opportunity to do what she loves: meeting new people, serving her community, and positively impacting the lives of others.

While Julie took great pride in her previous career, being given the opportunity to spend every day helping people’s retirement dreams come true in The Villages was one she knew she couldn’t pass up.

Julie is humbled and honored to be a Sales Representative for The Villages. She feels blessed to meet and learn from her guests each day and works tirelessly to ensure that their retirement goals are fulfilled. Earning the trust and friendship of a guest is an honor and a privilege that Julie will never take for granted.

Julie and Gary live in Middleton with their two children and Miniature Poodle. Joette and Hudson attend The Villages Charter School. The entire family loves the friendly, hometown community that The Villages provides to all who live and work here. Julie can help you sell your home, buy a new or pre-owned home, or purchase a homesite and personalize your dream home. She looks forward to meeting you and helping you in your next journey!

Bryce is a Florida native, born in Highlands County and raised in Gainesville. He spent his college days in Virginia before moving to California where he met and married his wife. They have three beautiful kids together and are happy to be raising them here in The Villages. They enjoy all the activities that are offered in the area, especially trips to the farmers market and dancing on the square.

Bryce spent most of his young professional life in the restaurant industry where he worked for almost ten years. While in California, he gained restaurant experience that would prove beneficial to his next career step. In 2016, he moved back to Florida where he used this expertise to help his parents successfully operate two restaurants. He started as General Manager at their first location, where they placed 12th out of over 500 locations in annual sales growth under his leadership. In 2019, he opened their second restaurant in The Villages. He attended corporate training in Charleston, South Carolina, and was responsible for hiring and training the entire staff. This environment is where he developed his service minded attitude and love for hospitality.

For Bryce, time not spent working or spent with family is spent on the golf course. Bryce has enjoyed picking the game back up from where he left off around fourteen years ago and enjoys the personal growth it can bring. He is excited for his new opportunity with Properties of The Villages and looks forward to helping future residents find their dream home.

Originally from Tyler, Texas, Sonja and her family have been visiting The Villages for more than 25 years. She and her husband, Billy, first fell in love with The Villages while visiting her mother in 2004. After many wonderful trips back with their children, Austin and Emily, they realized it wasn’t just a favorite vacation destination — it was the place they truly wanted to call home.

Since moving to The Villages, Sonja has fully embraced the incredible lifestyle that Florida’s Friendliest Hometown has to offer. Whether dancing at the town squares, swimming, playing golf, or cruising around in her black and hot pink golf car, she enjoys every opportunity to experience the beauty, energy, and strong sense of community that make The Villages so special.

After a fulfilling 30-year career in healthcare imaging, Sonja decided it was time for a new adventure and joined the team at Properties of The Villages. As a proud veteran of the United States Air Force and a longtime healthcare professional, she understands the value of dedication, integrity, and exceptional service.

Whether clients are searching for a new home, a pre-owned home, or a new construction opportunity in The Villages, Sonja is honored to guide them through every step of the process. For those interested in visiting The Villages, Sonja welcomes the opportunity to show them around and help them find the perfect home to fit their lifestyle.

Sonja looks forward to helping others discover why so many people are proud to call The Villages home.

Gail grew up in Florida and was raised in the Florida Keys and lived there for most of her life. She first learned about The Villages in 2013 when she helped her parents and handicapped sister move to Florida’s Friendliest Hometown. She and her family immediately fell in love with The Villages. For many years, she was a full-time caregiver for her loving sister with Downs syndrome.

Prior to starting her dream job with Properties of The Villages, Gail enjoyed a successful career in law firms in both the Florida Keys and NYC, where she lived for 10 years, and attended New York University to become a Real Estate Paralegal.

While living in The Villages, she and her family have had the pleasure of living in a pre-owned home in The Village of Largo, a newly constructed home in The Village of Pine Ridge and recently went through the “Personalize your Dream Home” experience after picking out a Homesite and building in The Village of Cason Hammock. All while gaining so many lifelong friendships along the way.

She is passionate about helping people, and by becoming a licensed Florida Real Estate Sales Representative she is able help others realize their retirement dream and find their perfect home.

Gail is an avid walker and enjoys spending hours taking pictures and chatting with fellow walkers on the many scenic trails. She also loves to travel, host game nights, and plan events for friends and family.

“I have been fortunate to live in some amazing places during my life, but nothing compares to The Villages. You truly have to live here to believe it. From the incredible neighbors and residents that you encounter daily, the entertainment, the beautiful scenery, having every convenience available to you, and the countless social and active-lifestyle clubs to enjoy, are just a few of the reasons I am proud to call The Villages home.”

Pam knew from her first visit in 2017 that The Villages was the place she wanted to call “home.” Getting here had some twists and turns along the way - born in Michigan, raised in Maryland, she and her husband moved to North Carolina to raise their three kids.

Pam began her professional career in the television industry working in production on shows such as Inside Edition, America’s Most Wanted, the Discovery Channel and a 12-part documentary series for the Library of Congress. After raising three children, her creative side took over and she began working in interior design and became a professional home stager, which naturally led to her love of real estate.

After becoming a licensed real estate agent in NC in 2016, she was honored to be awarded the Rising Star Award her first year, going on to be among the top 10% of her brokerage’s agents world-wide. Pam says that honor comes from her true passion for helping others and absolutely LOVING what she does. She looks forward to continuing that success in helping her fellow Villagers achieve their real estate goals.

Pam is also passionate about giving back and cherishes her volunteer time with the Tunnel to Towers Foundation – helping to organize and sponsor the Wake Forest, NC 5K race from 2018 to 2022. She is incredibly excited to serve as the Race Director for the upcoming 2023 Villages Tunnel to Towers 5k race. An avid tennis player, Pam volunteered her time and tennis skills to her local community and was honored to be named Volunteer of the Year for the Raleigh, NC USTA (United States Tennis Association) in 2017.

While she is absolutely focused on real estate and design, her true passion is her family - husband, Jeff, three kids - Rob, Jordan, and Jack, and her two dogs - Marley & Finn. When not helping Villagers as their trusted real estate advisor, you'll find her on the tennis courts, pickleball courts, or on the beach soaking up the amazing Florida sunshine.

Gary began fulfilling his ambitions right out of high school and for the next 4 1/2 decades celebrated the accomplishment of those dreams with the Indiana State Police and Indiana Supreme Court. One of the pinnacles of his two careers was graduating from the FBI National Academy 176th Session, which placed him in an elite class of law enforcement professionals that are known worldwide. His commitment to service has also been evident in his local church by serving in youth and refugee ministries over the years. He gives all credit for his accomplishments to the Lord and his loving family.

After making The Villages his home in 2019 he couldn't wait to share his excitement with family and friends by opening his home and sharing the wonder of The Villages to all that would listen and visit. That excitement and joy is his driving force in helping others to fulfil their dreams in The Villages.
